item.title: Steelers rule out Joey Porter Jr.; Jalen Ramsey hopes to play vs. Browns
item.description: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. will miss his fourth straight game when Pittsburgh visits the Cleveland Browns on Thursday night.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. will miss his fourth straight game when Pittsburgh visits the Cleveland Browns on Thursday night. Porter was limited in practice Wednesday after coach Mike McCarthy expressed hope earlier this week that he would make his season debut. Porter, 26, has been slowly recovering from a back injury and his conditioning has been improving. Fellow Pittsburgh cornerback Jalen Ramsey (wrist) is listed as questionable but hopes to play. He says he broke his right wrist early in Sunday's 30-27 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals. "I'm going to try to (play), but I've got to be able to protect it," Ramsey, an eight-time Pro Bowl selection, told reporters. "Obviously, it's a real injury. A broken wrist. I can't do anything about it." Running back Rico Dowdle (toe) will miss his second consecutive game and cornerback Brandin Echols (concussion) is questionable. Jaylen Warren will again be the primary running back for the Steelers. He had 176 scrimmage yards (127 rushing, 49 receiving) against Cincinnati. "What a tough guy," quarterback Aaron Rodgers said of Warren. "I've always had respect for him, played against him and then being his teammate now for a little more than a season. He is one of the toughest guys I've ever played with." For Cleveland, receiver Tylan Wallace (knee), center Elgton Jenkins (concussion) and guard Teven Jenkins (back) were ruled out. Teven Jenkins will miss his fourth straight game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Preços do açúcar bruto caem com vencimento do contrato de outubro na ICE
item.description: Os futuros do açúcar bruto na ICE caíram nesta quarta-feira, com o vencimento do contrato de outubro servindo de foco no curto prazo, enquanto os preços do café arábica registraram uma leve alta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os futuros do açúcar bruto na ICE caíram nesta quarta-feira, com o vencimento do contrato de outubro servindo de foco no curto prazo, enquanto os preços do café arábica registraram uma leve alta. AÇÚCAR * O contrato de açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,19 centavo, ou 1,1%, a 17,63 centavos por libra-peso. * Operadores afirmaram que a oferta permaneceu abundante, com o contrato de outubro fechando com um desconto de 1,02 centavos em relação ao de março em seu último dia de negociação. * O vencimento registrou entregas de 1,45 milhão de toneladas métricas, tendo a brasileira BTG Pactual Commodities como principal fornecedora e a asiática Wilmar como única receptora do açúcar, segundo os corretores. * As entregas ficaram em linha com as expectativas do mercado de um volume ligeiramente abaixo das 1,52 milhão de toneladas entregues no contrato de outubro de 2025. * O açúcar branco recuou 0,6%, para US$ 506,30 por tonelada. * Não houve participantes em uma licitação do Paquistão para vender e exportar 107.739 toneladas de açúcar branco, segundo os corretores . * A Índia registrou sua menor precipitação de monção em mais de uma década durante a temporada de junho a setembro, já que o fenômeno climático El Niño reduziu a precipitação. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em alta de 1,25 centavos, ou 0,4%, a US$2,907 por libra. * Os corretores afirmaram que o mercado foi impulsionado, em parte, por possíveis problemas de qualidade na safra brasileira de 2026, devido à maior umidade associada ao atual El Niño. * A Cooxupé, maior cooperativa cafeeira do Brasil e principal exportadora brasileira de café, informou em um comunicado aos seus produtores associados na terça-feira que rejeitará grãos com problemas de qualidade causados pelo excesso de umidade. * Os corretores afirmaram que a alta nos preços também foi impulsionada, em parte, por questões técnicas, com o mercado apresentando sobrevenda após uma queda acentuada em relação aos picos recentes registrados no final de agosto. * O café robusta subiu 1%, para US$ 3.445 a tonelada. (Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian digital lender Nubank said on Wednesday it is not pursuing a transaction with Monzo, after [USN:L1N45I02A TEXT:"media reports"] had said Nubank was in early-stage talks to acquire the British digital bank. In a securities filing, Nubank said it regularly evaluates opportunities that could support growth and long-term goals, including investments and acquisitions Nubank, which is listed as Nu Holdings (NU.N) , said its capital allocation framework is unchanged Nubank said it is focused on its strategic priorities: "deepening its position in Brazil, scaling its businesses in Mexico and Colombia, and building its presence in the United States and around the world through Nu Global" Shares in Nu Holdings [USN:L6N45M1BJ TEXT:"were up"] nearly 7% in trading in New York, after falling earlier this week on the media reports

item.title: Más de 270 sacerdotes de Massachusetts abusaron de menores durante décadas, según investigación
item.description: Más de 270 clérigos católicos abusaron sexualmente de casi 1.000 niños en tres diócesis de Massachusetts durante de varias décadas, según un informe de investigación publicado el miércoles por la fiscal general del estado.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: Más de 270 clérigos católicos abusaron sexualmente de casi 1.000 niños en tres diócesis de Massachusetts durante de varias décadas, según un informe de investigación publicado el miércoles por la fiscal general del estado. El informe ofrece lo que la fiscal general de Massachusetts, Andrea Joy Campbell, ha calificado como el primer recuento público completo de los abusos y las deficiencias institucionales que permitieron que estos se extendieran durante más de medio siglo en las diócesis católicas de Fall River, Springfield y Worcester. La mayor parte de los abusos detallados en el informe tuvieron lugar antes de 2002, año en que el escándalo de los abusos sexuales por parte del clero saltó a la palestra internacional a raíz de un reportaje del Boston Globe, galardonado con el Premio Pulitzer, sobre cómo los responsables de la Arquidiócesis católica romana de Boston encubrían sistemáticamente los abusos sexuales cometidos por sacerdotes. La investigación de la fiscalía general del estado documentó años de problemas similares en las tres diócesis de otras zonas de Massachusetts, las cuales Campbell dijo que sabían que los niños estaban siendo abusados por sacerdotes. "Con demasiada frecuencia protegieron la reputación de la Iglesia en lugar de proteger a los niños", dijo Campbell. "Detrás de cada una de esas cifras hay un niño cuya seguridad fue vulnerada, una familia que quedó marcada para siempre y un superviviente que ha cargado con el trauma de ese abuso durante años y, en muchos casos, décadas", dijo Campbell a los periodistas. La Diócesis de Worcester, en un comunicado, dijo que estudiaría el informe "para identificar cualquier otra mejora que se pueda realizar para atender a las víctimas de abusos cometidos en el pasado y para seguir reforzando los esfuerzos destinados a garantizar la seguridad de los niños". El obispo de Fall River, Edgar da Cunha, pidió perdón a los supervivientes de abusos sexuales infantiles y dijo que estaba "lleno de dolor ante el relato histórico de los incidentes y prácticas que reflejan los trágicos fallos a la hora de proteger a nuestros más vulnerables". La investigación periodística del Boston Globe de 2002, que más tarde se plasmó en la película de 2015 "Spotlight", desencadenó una ola mundial de investigaciones que revelaron patrones similares en diócesis de todo el mundo e impulsó a la Asamblea Legislativa de Massachusetts a aprobar una serie de reformas. En 2019, la entonces fiscal general Maura Healey, ahora gobernadora de Massachusetts, puso en marcha una investigación penal sobre las diócesis católicas romanas de Fall River, Springfield y Worcester para determinar si estas o sus líderes tenían responsabilidad alguna en relación con la supervisión del clero que abusó de menores. Campbell, quien dijo haber sido ella misma víctima de abusos infantiles a manos de un familiar, señaló que su oficina remitió tres casos a los fiscales del distrito locales durante la investigación, lo que dio lugar a la formulación de cargos en un caso en Worcester. Su oficina no llevó a cabo ningún proceso judicial debido a que algunas conductas no eran ilegales en el momento en que ocurrieron o porque habían prescrito, explicó. Campbell señaló que el informe ponía de manifiesto la necesidad de que las diócesis pongan en marcha reformas y de que se aprueben nuevas leyes estatales en apoyo de los supervivientes de abusos, incluida la eliminación de la prescripción para las demandas civiles relacionadas con abusos sexuales en la infancia.

item.title: CScale raises $145 million for AI networking, with backing from Nvidia and Intel
item.description: CScale, a Silicon Valley startup developing a way to connect AI chips with fiber-optic cables instead of fiber, said on Wednesday it has raised $145 million in venture capital, with backing from Nvidia and Intel .
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: CScale, a Silicon Valley startup developing a way to connect AI chips with fiber-optic cables instead of fiber, said on Wednesday it has raised $145 million in venture capital, with backing from Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Intel (INTC.O) . The company, which formerly went by the name CSpeed and has given few details about its technology, is being led by CEO Martin Lund, who left his post [USN:L6N3Z51BH TEXT:"overseeing chip and hardware systems"] for networking giant Cisco Systems (CSCO.O) earlier this year. With the funding, CScale is joining a scramble in Silicon Valley to replace the copper cables that wire together the chips inside AI data center servers with optical cables. Copper cables are fast and reliable, but have limited reach. Those reach limits have forced chip designers such as Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) to pack their processors tightly together inside servers, which in turn requires elaborate liquid cooling systems because of the heat generated by the chips. [USN:L4N3X81HQ TEXT:"Public companies"] and [USN:L6N4511GY TEXT:"startups"] alike are pouring billions of dollars into replacing those connections with optical connections that use flashes of laser light instead of electrons to carry data. But those lasers are prone to frequent failures, and so many of the firms chasing technology keep the laser separate from the chip so that it can be replaced. In an interview, Lund declined to give specifics of CScale's technology except to say that the company will integrate lasers onto the chips in a way that does not interrupt the flow of data when the lasers fail. "We're not using any exotic technologies," Lund said. "We're using proven technologies, integrating them together in a novel way, but preserving the same trusted fiber technology that has been out there and shipping in the industry for many, many years now." Lund said CScale, which has raised $188 million to date, plans to ship its chips by 2028. Leading the financing round were Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners and Premji Invest. Existing investors Sutter Hill Ventures and Maverick Silicon also took part in the funding announced on Wednesday.

item.title: Mickelson sought treatment at addiction center, TMZ reports

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LIV Golf player Phil Mickelson checked himself into an addiction treatment center due to "family trauma and addiction", TMZ reported on Wednesday . The outlet said that Mickelson had already checked out of the facility, citing a statement from one of his representatives. Reuters was not immediately able to reach Mickelson's team for comment. The American six-times major [USN:L6N40L1BK TEXT:"winner said"] in April that he was taking an extended break from competitive golf, citing a personal health matter. He had played just one event for the LIV Golf circuit this year. He [USN:L6N41I11O TEXT:"later withdrew"] from the PGA Championship citing a family health reasons.

item.title: Trading Day: Shrugging off a volatile September, markets shuffle into Q4
item.description: US stocks gyrated on Wednesday, caught in the tug-of-war of mixed signals.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp
item.content:encoded: US stocks gyrated on Wednesday, caught in the tug-of-war of mixed signals. Cooler-than-expected inflation data tempered rate hike expectations from the Federal Reserve, while upbeat GDP, consumer spending and private payrolls data underscored US economic resilience. Even so, rising crude prices kept inflation jitters alive, while long-dated US Treasury yields moved higher for the seventh straight day. The S&P 500 and the Dow lost ground on the week, while the Nasdaq advanced. For the quarter, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq posted gains, but the Dow ended the July-September period lower. item.title: Etihad to seek legal advice after Premier League’s Man City findings
item.description: Abu Dhabi-based airline Etihad Airways said on Wednesday it was seeking legal advice on its options after criticising the Premier League’s handling of an independent commission's findings against Manchester City.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: Abu Dhabi-based airline Etihad Airways said on Wednesday it was seeking legal advice on its options after criticising the Premier League’s handling of an independent commission's [USN:L6N45L10S TEXT:"findings against"] Manchester City. The Premier League said on Tuesday that City had used "sham" commercial contracts as part of schemes to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than £900 million ($1.2 billion) over nearly a decade. Etihad, City's principal sponsor since 2009, said it "categorically rejects any finding, conclusion or implication" that it was involved in improper commercial arrangements. In a statement, the airline said the league never contacted or consulted it during the commission process and gave it no opportunity to provide information or challenge material that may have reflected adversely on the company. "Etihad is deeply concerned by the way this matter has been communicated publicly," the statement said. "The lack of clarity and transparency, together with the selective disclosure of information, has created damaging implications for Etihad despite the airline not being named in the published decision." City have denied any wrongdoing and said they intend to appeal. A Premier League spokesperson said on Wednesday they would not be commenting on the Etihad statement. Etihad added that the Premier League's public communication of the findings, following what it described as selective leaks and reporting, had harmed its reputation. While reaffirming its support for Manchester City and its longstanding partnership with the club, the airline said it was seeking legal advice on the options available to protect its interests. "We stand with the club, its supporters and our wider Etihad community as Manchester City challenges the commission's conclusions through the processes available to it," the statement said.

item.title: Arizona court says judge wrongly allowed AI-generated victim video
item.description: An Arizona appeals court on Wednesday ordered a new sentencing hearing for a man convicted of a fatal road-rage shooting, finding that a judge improperly relied on an AI-generated video depicting the victim speaking about forgiveness and addressing the defendant directly.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: An Arizona appeals court on Wednesday ordered a new sentencing hearing for a man convicted of a fatal road-rage shooting, finding that a judge improperly relied on an AI-generated video depicting the victim speaking about forgiveness and addressing the defendant directly. The order by a three-judge panel of the Arizona Court of Appeals vacates a 10.5-year prison term for the alleged shooter, Gabriel Horcasitas, and returns the case to the lower court to redetermine his sentence. The appeals court upheld the defendant’s manslaughter conviction but said the AI-generated video should not have been allowed during sentencing. “While the record does not reflect precisely how the AI video factored into the sentencing calculus, there is no question it played a role,” wrote Judge D. Steven Williams, joined by Judge Anni Hill Foster and Vice Chief Judge David Weinzweig. The court said the trial judge’s “consideration of the AI video so prejudiced Horcasitas as to render the sentencing procedure fundamentally unfair.” The Arizona attorney general’s office declined to comment. A public defender representing Horcasitas also declined to comment. The presentation of the video last year at the sentencing hearing appeared to be one of the first such instances in a US courtroom. State and federal courts across the country are weighing guidelines and rules for the use of AI technology, including evidentiary matters. Horcasitas argued the video was not reliable and should not have been allowed. Prosecutors defended the inclusion of the video. Crime victims and their family members and friends generally are allowed to address a court at the time of a defendant’s sentencing. The video was made by the victim’s family and depicted an AI-generated avatar of Christopher Pelkey, who was shot and killed in a 2021 road-rage incident. The video made clear that it featured an AI version of Pelkey, an Army veteran who was 37 when he was killed. "It is a shame we encountered each other that day in those circumstances," the Pelkey avatar says in the video. "In another life, we probably could have been friends." The avatar told the court that the video was the “true representation of who I was.” Pelkey’s sister Stacey Wales [USN:L1N3RG1LO TEXT:"told Reuters last year"] that she scripted the AI-generated message. She said her goal was “to humanize Chris, to reach the judge, and let him know his impact on this world and that he existed.” Read more: [USN:L6N45L181 TEXT:"Florida lawyer denies submitting ‘AI slop’ in bid to dodge court sanctions"] [USN:L1N3RG1LO TEXT:"Family creates AI video to depict Arizona man addressing his killer in court"] [USN:L6N44S0X9 TEXT:"Mississippi asks appeals court to reassign judge over 'error-plagued' AI-assisted ruling"] [USN:L6N43I17W TEXT:"US judge warns Justice Department about AI use in immigration case"]

item.title: Petróleo sobe cerca de US$1 por barril com impasse nas negociações EUA-Irã
item.description: Os preços do petróleo subiram cerca de US$1 por barril nesta quarta-feira e registraram fortes ganhos mensais, devido ao impasse nas negociações de paz entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e ao aperto nos mercados de combustíveis dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Laila Kearney
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo subiram cerca de US$1 por barril nesta quarta-feira e registraram fortes ganhos mensais, devido ao impasse nas negociações de paz entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã e ao aperto nos mercados de combustíveis dos EUA. O contrato futuro do Brent para novembro , com vencimento nesta quarta-feira, fechou com alta de 91 centavos, ou 0,9%, a US$103,50 por barril. O contrato mais ativo, para dezembro , subiu US$1,87, ou 1,9%, para US$98,03. O petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos fechou a US$90,42, com alta de US$1,04, ou 1,2%. O Brent registrou um ganho mensal de cerca de 14%, o maior desde julho, enquanto o WTI subiu cerca de 5% no mês. O Catar afirmou na terça-feira que espera que a diplomacia itinerante entre Teerã e Washington possa levar a um avanço. No entanto, o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, negou reportagens da Axios e da CNN que citavam autoridades americanas afirmando que ele estaria disposto a conceder alívio nas sanções ao Irã e liberar fundos iranianos congelados em troca de medidas “concretas” por parte de Teerã em relação ao seu programa nuclear. A Arábia Saudita retomou na terça-feira o carregamento de petroleiros em seu porto de Yanbu, no Mar Vermelho, após reiniciar as operações do oleoduto Leste-Oeste. O Goldman Sachs estima que as exportações de petróleo do Golfo tenham se recuperado para 23,3 milhões de barris por dia na última semana, em linha com a média prevista para 2025, já que as exportações dobraram em setembro, segundo nota divulgada na terça-feira. Nos últimos cinco dias, a média de 10 dias para o total de exportações de petróleo se manteve em 20,5 milhões de bpd, ou 89% dos níveis de 2025, segundo estimativas do JPMorgan. Os países produtores de petróleo da Opep+ provavelmente manterão suas metas de produção estáveis para novembro quando se reunirem no domingo, disseram à Reuters duas pessoas a par do assunto.

item.title: Astros OF Daulton Varsho (wrist) done for season after surgery
item.description: Houston Astros outfielder Daulton Varsho underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Tuesday and is done for the season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Houston Astros outfielder Daulton Varsho underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Tuesday and is done for the season. He had been dealing with cysts in the wrist most of the season and was placed on the 10-day injured list on Sept. 24. Varsho, 30, split the season with the Toronto Blue Jays (99 games) and Astros (41) and batted .221 with 12 homers and 40 RBIs in 140 games. He hit just .172 with Houston after being acquired at the trade deadline. He is a career .226 hitter with 111 homers and 335 RBIs in 788 regular-season games with the Arizona Diamondbacks (2020-22), Blue Jays (2023-26) and Astros. He won a Gold Glove with Toronto in 2024. Houston is hosting the Chicago White Sox in Game 2 of the American League wild-card series on Wednesday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson 'dealing with something small'
item.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson raised initial concerns after he wasn't spotted during the beginning of practice open to the media on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson raised initial concerns after he wasn't spotted during the beginning of practice open to the media on Wednesday. Jackson eventually took the field -- albeit in a limited fashion -- prompting head coach Jesse Minter to open his press conference with an update on the status of the two-time NFL MVP. "Lamar was at practice in a little limited role. Just dealing with something small," Minter said. "That was good. I had heard that maybe that was sheer pandemonium that he wasn't out there earlier. He ended up being able to get some stuff done." Jackson, 29, has completed 69.7% of his passes (53 of 76) for 745 yards with four touchdowns and one interception in three games for the Ravens (2-1), who host the Tennessee Titans (0-3) on Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Amazon agrees to extend Kirk Herbstreit's contract but can replace him
item.description: Kirk Herbstreit has agreed to a contract extension to remain in the broadcast booth on "Thursday Night Football" on Amazon Prime Video, which can replace him if another choice for game analyst becomes available, The Athletic reported on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kirk Herbstreit has agreed to a contract extension to remain in the broadcast booth on "Thursday Night Football" on Amazon Prime Video, which can replace him if another choice for game analyst becomes available, The Athletic reported on Wednesday. Top alternatives could include current Los Angeles Rams coach Sean McVay, who has spoken publicly about a future in television. The musical chairs in the announcer booths could include ESPN analyst Troy Aikman and Fox analyst Greg Olsen, who are in the final years of their contracts, and current Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce, should he retire, The Athletic article noted. The caveat in Herbstreit's new deal, which is for multiple seasons and eight figures annually, per The Athletic, comes as he is at the end of his initial five-year contract with Prime Video. McVay, now 40, reportedly was recruited by Prime Video before it hired Herbstreit five years ago. Herbstreit, 57, also is in the final season of his contract with ESPN, for whom he is a long-running commentator on "College GameDay" and is slotted as the network's top college football game analyst. ESPN will address Herbstreit's contract status after this college football season, per the report. A former Ohio State quarterback (1989-92) who did not play in the NFL, Herbstreit has been with ESPN for more than three decades. He has been doing double duty as an NFL commentator with iconic play-by-play caller Al Michaels, 81, who is on year-to-year contracts, per The Athletic. According to the report, Prime Video in 2022 was interested in McVay, Aikman and San Francisco 49ers general manager John Lynch for the game analyst position, while Michaels favored his former broadcast partner Cris Collinsworth, who chose to stay with NBC's "Sunday Night Football." --Field Level Media

item.content:encoded: O Parlamento português aprovou nesta quarta-feira, em primeira votação, uma polêmica reforma do mercado de aluguéis que visa acelerar os despejos e acabar com os controles de aluguel nos novos contratos, numa medida que o governo de centro-direita espera que incentive os proprietários a colocar mais imóveis no mercado. A reforma, criticada por associações de inquilinos como “barbárie”, contrasta fortemente com os acontecimentos na vizinha Espanha, onde o governo de esquerda decretou, na terça-feira, a proibição de despejos de inquilinos vulneráveis até 2030, juntamente com outras medidas, em meio a protestos contra despejos e o aumento dos aluguéis. As linhas gerais da reforma foram aprovadas graças à abstenção do partido de extrema-direita Chega, que também havia manifestado suas objeções durante o debate, enquanto todos os partidos de esquerda votaram contra.

item.title: Toyota invertirá 1.341 millones de dólares en una planta de producción en Argentina
item.description: El fabricante de automóviles Toyota Motor invertirá 1.341 millones de dólares en la construcción de una planta de producción en Argentina, anunció el miércoles el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El fabricante de automóviles Toyota Motor (7203.T) invertirá 1.341 millones de dólares en la construcción de una planta de producción en Argentina, anunció el miércoles el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo. La planta fabricará un vehículo totalmente eléctrico, dijo Caputo, que añadió que se espera que genere 1.280 millones de dólares en exportaciones anuales y cree más de 2.600 puestos de trabajo durante su fase operativa. El proyecto fue aprobado bajo el esquema del Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones (RIGI) y representa la inversión más grande de la historia en la industria automotriz de Argentina, agregó el ministro.

item.title: Stella McCartney spotlights climate crisis with ocean-inspired Paris runway show
item.description: Stella McCartney put a spotlight on the impact of overfishing and climate change on the oceans in her Paris runway show on Wednesday, unveiling a Spring/Summer 2027 collection of floaty fabrics, bubble hems and wave motifs.
item.dc:creator: Helen Reid
item.content:encoded: Stella McCartney put a spotlight on the impact of overfishing and climate change on the oceans in her Paris runway show on Wednesday, unveiling a Spring/Summer 2027 collection of floaty fabrics, bubble hems and wave motifs. Killer whales, sharks and dolphins featured on several looks, while models carried transparent handbags with sea creatures such as a starfish inside. "The fishing industry is stealth, it's war, we're at war with the ocean, we're at war with the creatures that live in there," McCartney, a vegetarian, said after the show, adding that she wanted people to ask themselves: "Sea life or seafood — what's my choice?" McCartney's eponymous brand is known for using no leather, unlike most luxury labels, and for investing in more sustainably produced cotton, wool and other materials. Her handbags are made with leather alternatives produced from mushrooms or grape byproducts sourced from vineyards. In the leafy gardens of the British ambassador's residence, the show started with a voiceover from British natural historian and broadcaster David Attenborough saying: "We must open our eyes to what is happening right now below the waves - we have drained the life from our ocean." Models strode down a white runway in low-rise trousers with raised waves embroidered on the hips, tops with voluminous bubble hems, and fluid, sheer blazers and shirts. The colour palette also evoked ocean life with dresses in aqua and bright blue, and a coral trench coat. McCartney, who bought her brand back from luxury giant LVMH at the start of last year, called on big luxury brands to invest in scaling up more sustainable materials like organic cotton or lab-grown wool. "I think they all have good intentions, I just know that it would help me and smaller brands trying to come up and trying to work in this way, if the big brands just accepted a new way of working and a new supply chain," she said.

item.title: Republican US Senator Blackburn blocks Trump's pick for judge in Tennessee
item.description: US Senator Marsha Blackburn has taken the rare step as a Republican lawmaker of blocking at least for now one of US President Donald Trump's judicial nominees by withholding support for a White House lawyer nominated to serve on the bench in her home state.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: US Senator Marsha Blackburn has taken the rare step as a Republican lawmaker of blocking at least for now one of US President Donald Trump's judicial nominees by withholding support for a White House lawyer nominated to serve on the bench in her home state. Samuel Adkisson, who serves in the White House Counsel's Office as an associate counsel, had been expected to appear before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Wednesday in connection with his nomination last month by Trump to become a judge on the US District Court for the Eastern District of Tennessee. But the panel did not take up Adkisson's nomination after Blackburn, a member of the committee who is running to be Tennessee's governor, did not return a so-called "blue slip" supporting his nomination, according to a committee aide. Senators must return blue slips, named for the color of the forms, to the Senate Judiciary Committee in order for district court judge nominees from their home states to be considered, giving the senators leverage over who the White House picks. It was unclear why Blackburn, who was not at Wednesday's hearing, did not submit a blue slip supporting Adkisson, who previously worked under Senator Chuck Grassley in his role as the panel's chairman during US Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh's 2018 confirmation hearing. Representatives for Blackburn, Grassley and the White House did not respond to requests for comment. In nominating Adkisson, Trump in a social media post last month credited him for his work on "numerous important cases," highlighting his work in particular on [USN:L1N4310PO TEXT:"Trump v. Slaughter"], in which the high court in June said the president had broad authority to fire regulatory agency heads. Tennessee's other Republican senator, Bill Hagerty, had at the time of Adkisson's nomination hailed the choice, noting he had previously also served as a law clerk to Supreme Court Chief Justice John Roberts. Blackburn did not comment publicly on the nomination. Mike Davis, a Trump ally who runs the conservative group the Article III Project, in a post on X late Tuesday called Blackburn's decision to block Adkisson a "stunning development" and a "grave mistake." "We could not get a more brilliant, conservative, bold, and fearless pick for the federal bench," Davis wrote. Adkisson was not the only nominee to be absent from Wednesday's hearing, the last scheduled on judicial nominees before the November 2 midterm elections in which Democrats hope to [USN:L1N4500N3 TEXT:"reclaim control"] of the Republican-led Senate. Grassley kicked the session off by saying that due to delays in getting background investigation paperwork from the FBI, Brad Kelley, a partner at law firm Littler Mendelson, nominated to a judgeship in the Eastern District of Louisiana, would also not be considered at the meeting. "This was a delay in getting paperwork from the FBI, and I’m confident that Mr. Kelley will sit for our next hearing," Grassley said.

item.title: Smiles and respect as Fury and Joshua have first face off ahead of December fight
item.description: Former heavyweight world champions Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua came face to face on Wednesday as their long-awaited clash finally looked real after years of doubt, even in recent days, that they would ever get it together.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Former heavyweight world champions Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua came face to face on Wednesday as their long-awaited clash finally looked real after years of doubt, even in recent days, that they would ever get it together. The pair, 38 and 36 years old respectively and veterans some way past their prime, are due to meet at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on December 11 with tickets going on sale on October 9. Appearing together at a London 'news conference' -- although the only reporter who tried to ask a question from the floor was told 'no journalists' by Joshua -- the two big men showed mutual respect mixed with fighting talk and occasional digs at each other without losing their calm. With doors also opened to the public and a rowdy crowd in attendance for a show with lights and fireworks, Joshua called for a minute's silence for two close friends[USN:L1N3XZ09S TEXT:" killed in a car crash"] in Nigeria late last year. The catcalls and heckling stopped immediately, the Olympia hall completely hushed as the time ticked past. OLD SPARRING STORIES AND BLACK EYES Fury, the 'Gypsy King', was asked earlier about singing Joshua's praises after a sparring session years ago when his opponent was still in the amateur ranks and when he offered him a Rolex watch if he could knock him down. "Guess what? I left that building with a Rolex on," said Fury with a smile. Joshua, in dark glasses and a white T-shirt, added his own postscript that Fury had also left with a black eye. The respectful mood continued, with Fury shunning much of his usual bombast: "This man is a two-time heavyweight world champion, Olympic gold medallist and he has been a role model and a poster boy for British boxing for years," he declared of Joshua. "I mostly find myself defending my arch rival to fans I meet in the street and I say to them if you could achieve 10% of what this man has achieved, you'd be doing well. That aside, we're here to fight and fight we will, and I'm looking forward to the challenge. It's been 10 years in the making." The older Briton described himself as "bald, fat, bearded, ugly, slow and ponderous", to which Joshua laughingly replied "it's true". "Whatever people want to say," continued Fury. "But at the end of the day I get shit done. "This man is built like an Adonis and I'm built like a blancmange," he added. "He's made of marble, but every time he gets cracked on the jaw, he falls over. And when I crack him on that jaw, he's going to go down like a ton of bricks." Both men spoke of the significance of holding the fight in Britain rather than in the United States or Saudi Arabia, with Netflix providing the platform and Ring Magazine owner and Saudi promoter Turki Alalshikh the money man making it happen. Fury said it would be the "biggest of our time and of our generation". "It's an unbelievable event, because it's been simmering nicely for a decade and a half," he added. "We've had our ups and downs, and finally now near the end of it all, we get to fight each other." The final face off for the cameras ended in smiles, with Joshua pretending to tickle Fury who had suggested earlier that they might even go for a pint once the fight was done.

item.title: Senators will try to win approval of permanent Chinese car ban in November
item.description: The two US senators backing a permanent legislative ban on Chinese vehicles in the US will not seek approval until the Senate returns from recess in November, congressional aides said Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The two US senators backing a permanent legislative ban on Chinese vehicles in the US will not seek approval until the Senate returns from recess in November, congressional aides said Wednesday. Republican Senator Bernie Moreno said on Tuesday that he planned to seek fast-track approval for the stringent ban on Chinese vehicles this week before the Senate left ahead of the November congressional election . But supporters were unable to address the concerns of a holdout senator, Republican Rand Paul, who had raised concerns it was unfairly targeting Mercedes-Benz. The bill's other chief sponsor, Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin, said last week that all Democrats support moving ahead and she was hoping to get fast-track approval this week. Moreno said on Tuesday the final version of the bill would ensure that German automaker Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) is not banned from selling vehicles in the US. The bill approved by the Senate Commerce Committee in July would ban companies with more than 15% ownership by Chinese entities from selling vehicles in the US. Mercedes-Benz has nearly 20% passive ownership from Chinese entities. The bill has significant momentum and a House version now tops 100 co-sponsors, while automakers and legislative aides hope to win full passage this year. President Donald Trump told Fox News earlier this month that he would accept Chinese car companies building cars in the US, sparking alarm among automakers. Automakers, suppliers and dealers have urged Trump "to maintain policies that keep the door firmly shut to Chinese automakers seeking to sell, import or manufacture vehicles inside the US." A regulation imposed by the former Biden administration in early 2025 effectively banned all Chinese automakers from selling or building passenger vehicles in the US because they could send sensitive driver data to China. Washington also maintains more than 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles. The Chinese foreign ministry has previously urged the United States "to respect the laws of the market economy and principles of fair competition," criticizing previous proposals against Chinese companies as "unreasonable suppression."

item.title: Portugal parliament backs swifter evictions, end of rent caps
item.description: Portugal's parliament approved on Wednesday, in the first reading, a contentious rental market overhaul aimed to speed up evictions and end rent controls on new leases in what the centre-right government hopes will encourage landlords to put more homes on the market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Portugal's parliament approved on Wednesday, in the first reading, a contentious rental market overhaul aimed to speed up evictions and end rent controls on new leases in what the centre-right government hopes will encourage landlords to put more homes on the market. The reform, criticised by tenants' associations as "savagery", sharply contrasts with developments in neighbouring Spain where the leftist government on Tuesday [USN:L1N45L0A6 TEXT:"decreed"] a ban on evictions of vulnerable tenants until 2030, along with other measures, amid protests against evictions and rising rents. The general outline of the reform was approved thanks to the abstention of the far-right party Chega, which had also expressed its objections during the debate, while all of the left-wing parties voted against.

item.title: Google anuncia su modelo insignia de IA, Gemini 4, tras meses de retrasos
item.description: Google , filial de Alphabet, anunció el miércoles un nuevo modelo de inteligencia artificial de gama alta que servirá de pilar para su nueva generación de modelos "Gemini 4", en un nuevo intento por alcanzar a sus rivales Anthropic y OpenAI en la carrera por la IA.
item.dc:creator: Kenrick Cai
item.content:encoded: Google (GOOGL.O) , filial de Alphabet, anunció el miércoles un nuevo modelo de inteligencia artificial de gama alta que servirá de pilar para su nueva generación de modelos "Gemini 4", en un nuevo intento por alcanzar a sus rivales Anthropic y OpenAI en la carrera por la IA. El nuevo modelo "Argon" es de mayor tamaño que la anterior línea de modelos "Pro" de gama alta de Google, según ha declarado un portavoz de la empresa. "Es nuestro modelo más potente hasta la fecha, diseñado para cargas de trabajo complejas, y lo consideramos comparable a modelos de vanguardia como Astra (de OpenAI) y Opus (de Anthropic) en pruebas clave de codificación y ciberseguridad", afirmó el portavoz. Google ha indicado que está facilitando el modelo a socios seleccionados del ámbito de la ciberseguridad y que participa en el proceso voluntario del Gobierno de Donald Trump para el acceso a modelos antes de su lanzamiento. No ha facilitado una fecha prevista para el lanzamiento público del modelo.

item.title: Australia win rain-curtailed ODI against South Africa
item.description: Australia’s bowlers powered the tourists to a 45-run victory over South Africa under the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method on Wednesday, helping them avoid a whitewash in the three-match one-day international series.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia’s bowlers powered the tourists to a 45-run victory over South Africa under the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method on Wednesday, helping them avoid a whitewash in the three-match one-day international series. With test captain Pat Cummins competing in his first ODI in 22 months and Mitchell Starc restored to the team, Australia fielded a formidable attack after losing the opening two matches. But it was Xavier Bartlett, who removed both openers and finished with 2-25 from five overs, and Adam Zampa, who took 2-34 from six, who effectively stifled home hopes of chasing down a challenging target at the JB Marks Oval after Australia were put in to bat and scored 322-9. Rain brought a premature end to proceedings with South Africa on 145-4 after 28 overs, 46 runs short of their revised target of 191. Ryan Rickelton was unbeaten on 71 but running out of partners in a depleted batting line-up. South Africa rested captain Temba Bavuma, David Miller and Marco Jansen and saw Tony de Zorzi hurt his hamstring while fielding, which meant he could not bat. The wet weather also delayed the start of play, but Australia saw off any advantage South Africa hoped to gain out of the wicket with a 78-run partnership off 53 balls for the opening wicket between skipper Mitchell Marsh (56) and Travis Head (24). The 20-year-old Oliver Peake contributed 48, while Alex Carey top-scored with 74 to push Australia to an imposing total. South Africa won the first ODI in Durban by 67 runs and the second in Johannesburg by 32 runs. The two countries will now contest a three-test series starting in Durban next week.

item.title: S&P 500 recua, enquanto Nasdaq sobe após dados indicarem aumento moderado da inflação
item.description: O Nasdaq subiu nesta quarta-feira e o S&P 500 recuou, mas ambos os índices registraram seus segundos ganhos trimestrais consecutivos, já que um dado de inflação mais fraco do que o esperado amenizou as expectativas de que os formuladores de política monetária do Federal Reserve aumentem as taxas de juros em outubro.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: O Nasdaq subiu nesta quarta-feira e o S&P 500 recuou, mas ambos os índices registraram seus segundos ganhos trimestrais consecutivos, já que um dado de inflação mais fraco do que o esperado amenizou as expectativas de que os formuladores de política monetária do Federal Reserve aumentem as taxas de juros em outubro. O Departamento de Comércio dos EUA informou que o Índice de Preços de Despesas de Consumo Pessoal (PCE) subiu 3,4% na base anual em agosto, ficando abaixo da estimativa de 3,7% dos economistas consultados pela Reuters. Por outro lado, a estimativa final dos dados do PIB do segundo trimestre foi revisada para cima, para uma taxa anualizada de 2,2%, graças aos sólidos gastos do consumidor e aos investimentos que ajudaram a impulsionar a expansão da infraestrutura de IA. O aumento dos preços do petróleo bruto devido ao conflito entre os EUA e o Irã e os altíssimos custos do diesel alimentaram os temores de inflação e empurraram os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA para cima. Autoridades do Fed indicaram que mais aumentos nas taxas de juros podem ser necessários caso as pressões sobre os preços não se moderem após o banco central ter elevado as taxas de juros em 25 pontos-base neste mês. O rendimento do título do Tesouro dos EUA de 2 anos , que normalmente acompanha as expectativas de taxas de juros do Fed, inicialmente recuou após a divulgação dos dados, antes de voltar a subir levemente, enquanto os rendimentos de títulos de prazo mais longo continuaram subindo devido às expectativas de um crescimento econômico sólido. As expectativas do mercado de um aumento de pelo menos 25 pontos-base na reunião do Fed em outubro caíram para cerca de 39%, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME, ante aproximadamente 51% na sessão anterior e quase 71% há uma semana. Analistas também observaram que mudanças recentes na metodologia de cálculo do PCE pelo Bureau de Análise Econômica contribuíram para um resultado mais baixo. “O que o mercado está focando é: a economia continua crescendo e será que ela consegue lidar com essas taxas de juros mais altas? E eu diria que, até agora, o mercado tem se comportado de maneira semelhante ao que já foi observado no passado: quando a economia está crescendo, quando os lucros são sólidos e quando há uma tendência de longo prazo, ele ignora as taxas de juros mais altas”, disse Anthony Saglimbene, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Ameriprise Financial em Troy, Michigan. “No entanto... se essas taxas mais altas permanecerem nesses níveis elevados por mais tempo, é provável que comecem a causar danos potencialmente maiores ao segmento de títulos da carteira, o que poderia limitar o crédito ou o crédito disponível. E se os investidores começarem a perceber que essas condições podem pesar sobre o crescimento econômico ou sobre a lucratividade das empresas nos próximos um ou dois trimestres, então acredito que veremos uma reação negativa muito rápida no mercado.” S&P E NASDAQ REGISTRAM GANHOS TRIMESTRAIS O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,86%, para 50.906,05 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,25%, para 7.651,54 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) subiu 0,24%, para 26.861,06 pontos. O S&P chegou a subir 0,7%, enquanto o Nasdaq chegou a 1,2% de alta durante o pregão. No mês, o S&P 500 caiu 0,45%, o Nasdaq subiu 1,86% e o Dow Jones caiu 4,29%. O Dow Jones interrompeu uma sequência de cinco meses de ganhos, enquanto o S&P 500 registrou queda pelo terceiro mês em quatro. O Nasdaq registrou alta pelo segundo mês consecutivo. Tanto o S&P 500 quanto o Nasdaq registraram seus segundos avanços trimestrais consecutivos e o quinto nos últimos seis. O Dow sofreu uma queda trimestral pela segunda vez em três. A maioria das ações de megacapitalização e de crescimento registrou alta, com a Microsoft (MSFT.O) , a Apple (AAPL.O) e a Nvidia (NVDA.O) subindo, o que levou o índice de tecnologia do S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) a subir 0,6%, tornando-se o setor com melhor desempenho do dia. No entanto, nove dos 11 principais setores do S&P encerraram o dia em baixa. EMPREGO NO SETOR PRIVADO CRESCE EM SETEMBRO Um relatório sobre o mercado de trabalho mostrou que o emprego no setor privado cresceu em 90.000 vagas neste mês, após uma revisão para baixo de 36.000 em agosto, segundo o Relatório Nacional de Emprego da ADP. Os dados foram os mais recentes de uma série de relatórios sobre o mercado de trabalho nesta semana, que culminarão no importante relatório governamental sobre os empregos, a ser divulgado na sexta-feira. Sem abordar os dados de inflação mais fracos do que o esperado, a diretora do Fed Lisa Cook afirmou estar comprometida em reduzir a inflação sem prejudicar o mercado de trabalho, já que as pressões sobre os preços vêm sendo muito altas há muito tempo. Entre outras empresas que se destacaram, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) subiu 3,9% depois que a fabricante de servidores de IA elevou sua previsão de crescimento de receita de longo prazo para seu negócio de redes e anunciou um acordo de US$1,2 bilhão com a Vultr. A Moderna (MRNA.O) tombou 5,3% depois que a corretora Citigroup rebaixou sua recomendação para a empresa de biotecnologia de “neutra” para “venda”.

item.title: Trump says he has done a 'bad job' explaining his economic record
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Wednesday he has done "a very bad job" of explaining his economic record as his job approval rating sags under the weight of high gasoline prices ahead of the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Wednesday he has done "a very bad job" of explaining his economic record as his job approval rating sags under the weight of high gasoline prices ahead of the November midterm elections. Trump, speaking to a supportive crowd at a Hispanic Heritage Month event at the White House, made the comment as he prepares to embark on a [USN:L1N45L12S TEXT:"32-day campaign blitz"] for Republican candidates ahead of the November 3 elections that will decide whether his party retains control of the US Congress. "I've done a very bad job of explaining how good the country is doing," Trump said, insisting that "the country's doing better than it has ever done." Trump noted that the party in power usually loses congressional seats in the first election after a presidential election and urged his supporters to get out and vote. "We have to turn this around," he said. Many American voters, however, increasingly give Trump low marks in public opinion polls for his management of the economy, which has been buffeted by his global tariff policies and a war on Iran that sent energy prices soaring. US consumer confidence plunged to a near 12-1/2-year low in September, the Conference Board said on Tuesday, with households expecting a deterioration in business and labor market conditions over the next six months. Consumers have been downbeat on the labor market, despite job growth accelerating in August after hitting a speed bump through much of the summer. Home prices have increased as well, adding to the strain from rising mortgage rates. Trump travels to Texas and Oklahoma on Thursday with a stop in Alabama planned for Friday and one in Ohio on Saturday. The Republican Party is pouring millions of dollars into seats once considered safe but are now viewed as competitive as voters grow weary of the economic fallout of the Iran war. "We're not getting the word out," Trump said, referring to what he considers his strong stewardship of the economy. "I'm going out because nobody's selling it. We're doing an extremely poor job of promotion, and an extremely great job of running the country. But we'll get the word out. It should not be hard."

item.title: Micron forecasts quarterly revenue, profit above estimates on AI memory demand
item.description: Micron Technology forecast quarterly revenue above estimates on Wednesday, signaling it expects the AI-driven memory chip boom to continue powering its growth.
item.dc:creator: Anhata Rooprai
item.content:encoded: Micron Technology (MU.O) forecast quarterly revenue above estimates on Wednesday, signaling it expects the AI-driven memory chip boom to continue powering its growth. Shares of the Boise, Idaho-based company rose over 1% in extended trading. The stock has more than tripled so far this year. The generative AI boom has made high-bandwidth memory essential for data centers, benefiting companies such as Micron, a key supplier to Nvidia (NVDA.O) , whose pricey processors dominate advanced computing workflows. The company expects first-quarter revenue of $61.5 billion, plus or minus $1.5 billion, compared with analysts' average estimate of $57.02 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Adjusted profit is expected to be $38.15 per share in the first quarter, plus or minus $1, above estimates of $35.40. As the only major US-based HBM chipmaker, Micron has seen orders far exceed capacity, while the AI memory boom has tightened conventional chip supplies and driven prices higher across the broader semiconductor market. To meet demand, Micron is expanding aggressively and has lifted planned US investments to [USN:L6N43B0PQ TEXT:"over $250 billion through 2035"], as Amazon (AMZN.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) and other tech giants are set to spend more than $730 billion on AI infrastructure this year. "Micron's complete blowout earnings and forecast should put the nail in the coffin of the ongoing doubters about the resiliency of the AI buildout," said Bob O'Donnell, chief analyst at TECHnalysis Research. Fourth-quarter revenue more than quadrupled to $54.23 billion, beating estimates of $51.07 billion. Adjusted profit came in at $33.42 per share, exceeding estimates of $31.61.

item.title: Ibovespa avança e acumula alta de mais de 5% em setembro com aval de estrangeiro
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta quarta-feira, em pregão marcado por desempenho robusto das ações de bancos e dados de inflação abaixo das expectativas nos Estados Unidos, avançando 5% em setembro com apoio de estrangeiros.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta quarta-feira, em pregão marcado por desempenho robusto das ações de bancos e dados de inflação abaixo das expectativas nos Estados Unidos, avançando 5% em setembro com apoio de estrangeiros. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) subiu 1,37%, a 186.340,46 pontos, registrando uma alta de 5,03% no mês e de 8,32% no terceiro trimestre. Em 2026, acumula um ganho de 15,65%. De acordo com dados da B3, até o dia 28, a bolsa paulista registra uma entrada líquida de estrangeiros de R$9,569 bilhões em setembro, deixando o resultado no ano positivo em quase R$29 bilhões. Nesta quarta-feira, o Ibovespa marcou 187.834,97 pontos na máxima e 183.879,71 pontos na mínima. Nos EUA, o índice de [USN:ZON00GKHT TEXT:"preços de gastos com consumo"] (PCE, na sigla em inglês), subiu 0,3% em agosto, acima do aumento de 0,1% em julho após revisão, mas abaixo do incremento de 0,4% estimado por economistas. Excluindo os componentes voláteis de alimentos e energia, o índice PCE, medida de inflação preferida do Federal Reserve, subiu 0,2% no mês, ante acréscimo de 0,1% em julho e previsão do mercado de alta de 0,3%. A pauta norte-americana ainda mostrou uma criação de [USN:ZON00GKH9 TEXT:"empregos"] no setor privado acima das expectativas do mercado e uma revisão para cima do crescimento do [USN:ZON00GKHC TEXT:"PIB"] no segundo trimestre. Em Wall Street, porém, o índice acionário S&P 500 (.SPX) fechou em queda de 0,25%, enquanto o rendimento do título de 10 anos do Tesouro norte-americano marcava 5,2997% no final da tarde, de 5,255% na véspera. Para o especialista em investimentos Marcos Bassani, sócio da AW Capital, a alta do Ibovespa no dia refletiu, principalmente, um ambiente externo mais favorável, com dados de inflação nos EUA ajudando a reduzir a pressão sobre os juros norte-americanos. "Ainda assim, considero que o mercado permanece bastante sensível às questões fiscais e ao cenário eleitoral, o que pode manter a volatilidade elevada nos próximos pregões", acrescentou. Nesta quarta-feira, dados do Banco Central mostraram que a [USN:L1N45M0F3 TEXT:"dívida pública"] bruta do país como proporção do PIB fechou agosto em 82,9%, contra 82,6% em julho, embora abaixo do esperado por economistas (83%). O setor público consolidado registrou um déficit primário de R$10,012 bilhões no mês passado, mas menor do que a expectativa de um saldo negativo de R$15,7 bilhões. De acordo com economistas do JPMorgan, o déficit primário de agosto veio menor do que o esperado, impulsionado pelos superávits dos governos regionais e das estatais. Eles destacaram que os pagamentos de juros e os indicadores de dívida atingiram novos recordes, com a dívida líquida no maior nível da série histórica. "A execução fiscal continua volátil, enquanto as atenções permanecem voltadas para as promessas fiscais ligadas à campanha eleitoral. Novas promessas de gastos e medidas relacionadas aos combustíveis aumentam as incertezas em torno do Orçamento de 2027", acrescentaram em relatório a clientes. DESTAQUES

item.title: Google announces Gemini 4 flagship AI model after months of delays
item.description: Alphabet's Google on Wednesday announced a new top-shelf artificial intelligence model to anchor its new Gemini 4 generation of models in a fresh bid to catch up to rivals Anthropic and OpenAI in the AI race.
item.dc:creator: Kenrick Cai
item.content:encoded: Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) on Wednesday announced a new top-shelf artificial intelligence model to anchor its new Gemini 4 generation of models in a fresh bid to catch up to rivals Anthropic and OpenAI in the AI race. The new "Argon" model is larger in size than Google's previous line of top-tier "Pro" models, a company spokesperson said. "It's our most performant model yet built for complex workloads, and we see it comparable to frontier models like (OpenAI's) [USN:L6N44V0KT TEXT:"Astra"] and (Anthropic's) [USN:L6N45E0TU TEXT:"Opus"] on key coding and cyber benchmarks," the spokesperson said. Google said it was providing the model to select cybersecurity partners and was participating in the Trump administration's [USN:L1N45K0VR TEXT:"voluntary process"] for [USN:FWN42A0NO TEXT:"pre-release model access"]. It did not provide a timeline for the model's public release.

item.title: Toyota investirá US$1,34 bi em fábrica na Argentina
